beats.headline: First hands-on guide: LoRA fine-tuning for product images
Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo ships on Hugging Face with eight-step generation and a license caveat
OrcaRouter maps every Qwen Image release and the missing 2.5 step

open_questions: Does the Turbo license permit commercial use, given the base weights were reported as research-use only?
Does eight-step Turbo hold output quality against the base model on independent evals?
Do LoRA fine-tunes of the 7B model hold quality on product imagery beyond one walkthrough?
Will Alibaba ship a Qwen Image 2.5 release, and under what license?
editorial.take_for_builders: Confirm the license for both base and Turbo weights before any commercial use, then compare eight-step Turbo output against base Qwen-Image-2.1 on your own eval set for quality and latency.
editorial.tldr: Alibaba의 Qwen 팀은 9월 말 7B open-weight 이미지 생성·편집 모델 Qwen-Image-2.1을 공개했고, 10월 7일에는 제품 이미지용 LoRA fine-tuning 실습 가이드가 나왔습니다. 10월 9일에는 8단계 Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo가 라이선스 단서와 함께 Hugging Face에 올라왔습니다.
editorial.whats_new: Oct 13: an OrcaRouter guide catalogs every Qwen Image release, says which to use, and flags a gap where a 2.5 release would sit.
editorial.why_it_matters: An eight-step Turbo variant of a 7B image model cuts per-image latency and GPU cost for self-hosted pipelines, but the license decides whether it can ship commercially.
